summary.en: Satoru Tamai takes Emi Maeda to his mansion to have a 4-person class reunion with Kazuma Sasaki and Yosuke Okawa, and Tamai reveals that he and Maeda are engaged, much to the surprise of the other two and partly to Sasaki's jealousy. A month later, Tamai goes to Mouri Detective Agency to hire Kogoro to investigate the unusual events that have been happening around him and asks him to be his bodyguard. However, the next day when Kogoro and Conan arrive at Tamai's mansion, they find him drowned in the pool. Location: "Sunset" host club pool Victim: Satoru Tamai Time: Yesterday 12.30 p.m. Cause of death: Unknown Suspects: Emi Maeda, Kazuma Sasaki, and Yosuke Okawa The police arrive and begin interviewing the suspects based on the class reunion Maeda mentions when she is questioned later. First, Maeda had been practicing for her Mermaid live broadcast that morning when the victim died, and then had lunch; next is Okawa, he was having surgery on a patient at the time; and finally Sasaki, he was in court. All three of them recalled their shared memories from their school days. At the scene, Conan suddenly notices grass in the drain hole of the pool, which is quite strange in general, so he begins to investigate its mysterious origin. From there, Kogoro and Takagi follow him while Megure is still confused about what is happening. In addition, they also find strange traces on the bridge where it seems to be the place where the victim was pushed down. Meanwhile, Okawa and Sasaki are hiding in the bushes, looking surprised to see the three people investigating the bridge while recalling the real events that happened in the past. And after everyone watches the livestream video, Conan understands the truth of the matter and tranquilizes Kogoro.
